name: karmatrust-circuits
description: ZK circuits for KarmaTrust credit verification

scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/tier_membership.r1cs ptau/pot14_final.ptau build/tier_membership.zkey
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute build/tier_membership.zkey build/tier_membership_final.zkey --name='KarmaTrust Contributor'
scripts.export-vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/tier_membership_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.prove: snarkjs groth16 prove build/tier_membership_final.zkey build/tier_membership_js/witness.wtns build/proof.json build/public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify build/verification_key.json build/public.json build/proof.json
